description: This PHP source file handles the display and retrieval of related lists for the PriceBooks module in the vtiger CRM, including entity info retrieval, session management, permission checks, and template rendering.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Represents the CRM entity object for handling entity-specific logic and data.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: An extension of Smarty template engine tailored for vtiger CRM's views.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Loads the entity's info from the database based on record ID and module.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Provides update information (probably last modified info) for a record.

methods.description: Checks user permissions and returns button display options for a module.
